title: The golden workbook fails its own verifier after mandatory recalculation
evidence: Passing the supplied golden workbook through the verifier's mandatory LibreOffice recalculation and cell comparison produces regression 1.0000 and modification 0.9586: 97 of 2,343 modification cells fail, all in NCD. For example, AA137 expects -3.37507799486048e-13 but recalculates to -3.80140363631654e-13 with the same formula. The comparator applies a 1% relative tolerance whenever both numbers are nonzero, treating insignificant floating-point residuals as material changes. Because the sole verifier has weight 1 and requires every modification cell to match, the golden solution itself receives zero credit.
confirmation: Duplicate. NCD!AA137 expects -3.375e-13 and the verifier's recalc gives -3.801e-13 with the same formula, so the GT and all correct outputs fail the 1% relative check on noise values.

title: Graded answer range covers untouched sheets, so float/recalculation noise (e.g., NCD balance rows) is graded as modification and the ground truth fails its own verifier
evidence:
Same issue reported 2 times, differing only in the verifier/range/step cited:
- I copied gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx to output.xlsx and ran verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells with the spec parameters. Result: score=0.0, 'FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9586. 97 cell error(s)'. The 96 errors I listed are all NCD!AA134:BW134 and NCD!AA137:BW137 (Opening/Closing Balance rows such as =AA23+AA15+AA31+...). These rows should be zero but hold float residue. Cached values: input 1.0658e-14, golden -3.3751e-13, golden after the verifier's forced LibreOffice recalculation -3.8014e-13. Input and golden differ, so score_workbooks puts these cells in the modification bucket, and
- The task adds only 78 formulas: Fixed Asset & Depreciation E19:M19, DCF D10:L10 and D15:L15, WACC E15:G16, Revenue C31:Q31/C34:Q35. Yet answer_position spans essentially the whole workbook, including 'NCD'!B3:BW181, 'TL'!A1:BW376, 'Amortization with extra payment'!B1:P369 and two 1,855-row crude price data sheets. A structural diff of input vs golden shows the only non-formula differences in untouched sheets are 15th-significant-digit float changes, e.g. 'TL D52 31.3869854584649 -> 31.386985458465' and 'Ann 3 E18 3127.34849699999 -> 3127.348497'. Running the whole-workbook check is what expose
confirmation: The answer range spans untouched sheets (NCD, TL), where float residue in zero-balance rows (NCD AA134:BW137) differs between input, GT and recalc. Every trial fails on these cells despite completing the 78 requested formulas.
fix: files/gt/gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx: set the cached value of 4,657 formula cells whose cached value was floating-point residue (0 < |v| < 1e-9; NCD 1,981, TL 2,674, Cash Flow F48/H48) to exactly 0. Formulas and every other cell unchanged. The verifier's 1% relative test then becomes an absolute 0.01 test on these cells, so recalculation noise no longer fails. Local check: patched GT scores PASS against itself after the verifier's forced LibreOffice recalc

title: Verifier grades untouched floating-point zero-residuals (~1e-13) in NCD and TL using relative tolerance before rounding, causing even the golden workbook to fail
evidence: The task instructions require filling 78 formula cells across four sheets ('Fixed Asset & Depreciation'!E19:M19, 'DCF_Income Approach'!D10:L10 and D15:L15, 'WACC'!E15:G16, and 'Revenue'!C31:Q31 and C34:Q35), while explicitly stating: 'strictly avoid altering any cells that already contain values unless explicitly instructed.' However, the sole verifier 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (weight: 1) checks 43 sheet ranges including 'NCD'!B3:BW181 and 'TL'!A1:BW376. Neither NCD nor TL is referenced by or dependent on the four modified sheets, and every formula and input in NCD and TL is identical between untouched_input_14_05_Refinery_input.xlsx and gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx. Because untouched_input was saved by Excel (15-digit precision, e.g. NCD!F15 = 1063.0143597875) and gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx was re-saved by LibreOffice 7.3.7.2 (full IEEE-754 double precision, e.g. NCD!F15 = 1063.01435978749), cumulative amortisation balances that are mathematically 0 differ at the ~1e-14 to ~1e-13 level (776 cells in NCD with max abs 3.38e-13, and 888 cells in TL with max abs 1.00e-13). In verifiers/spreadsheetbench2.py, _values_match (lines 102-104) checks _within_tolerance(v1, v2) on raw unrounded floats BEFORE calling _transform_value (which rounds floats to 2 decimal places), and _within_tolerance (lines 90-95) uses relative error abs(v1 - v2) / max(abs(v1), abs(v2)) <= 0.01 whenever neither float is literally 0.0. Consequently, those 1,664 near-zero floating-point noise cells in NCD and TL are misclassified as 'Modification' cells, and when the verifier recalculates any submission in LibreOffice 26.2.4.2, 97 cells in NCD (e.g., NCD!AA137: golden=-3.37507799486048e-13 vs recalculated=-3.80140363631654e-13) and 551 cells in TL fail the 1% relative tolerance check. Even grading gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx against itself scores 0.0 (FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9586, 97 cell errors in NCD).
confirmation: Verified that NCD!AA137/AB134/AC137 have identical formulas in input and GT but cached residuals 1.07e-14 vs -3.38e-13, making them modification cells. Run grades fail on exactly these with recalculated -3.80e-13, more than 1% relative error at near-zero values.
fix: files/gt/gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx: set the cached value of 4,657 formula cells whose cached value was floating-point residue (0 < |v| < 1e-9; NCD 1,981, TL 2,674, Cash Flow F48/H48) to exactly 0. Formulas and every other cell unchanged. The verifier's 1% relative test then becomes an absolute 0.01 test on these cells, so recalculation noise no longer fails. Local check: patched GT scores PASS against itself after the verifier's forced LibreOffice recalc

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: Untouched NCD balance cells differ between reference and GT only by float noise (AA137 1.07e-14 vs -3.38e-13) and recalc to -3.80e-13, so even the GT fails the all-or-nothing check. The 'never reached grader' guess is wrong, but the shortfall is real.
fix: files/gt/gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx: set the cached value of 4,657 formula cells whose cached value was floating-point residue (0 < |v| < 1e-9; NCD 1,981, TL 2,674, Cash Flow F48/H48) to exactly 0. Formulas and every other cell unchanged. The verifier's 1% relative test then becomes an absolute 0.01 test on these cells, so recalculation noise no longer fails. Local check: patched GT scores PASS against itself after the verifier's forced LibreOffice recalc

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells trivially fails (score 0.0) on all 3 units despite every unit producing the exact ground-truth formulas
evidence: Across all 3 units (unit 1 step [55], unit 2 step [46], unit 3 step [50]), the agent inspected the workbook, identified all 78 missing formula cells requested by the prompt ('Fixed Asset & Depreciation'!E19:M19, 'DCF_Income Approach'!D10:L10 and D15:L15, 'WACC'!E15:G16, 'Revenue'!C31:Q31 and C34:Q35), wrote the exact ground-truth formulas via LibreOffice UNO, and saved /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx without errors. Yet 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (weight: 1) returned the exact same verdict on all 3 units: 'score=0 - FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.7708. 648 cell error(s): Modification error at NCD!AA137: answer=-3.37507799486048e-13, output=-3.80140363631654e-13...'. All 648 cell errors (97 in NCD and 551 in TL) are IEEE-754 floating-point rounding residuals (~1e-13 around zero) on untouched sheets caused by comparing raw floats with relative error before rounding in _values_match, plus floating-point drift between LibreOffice 7.3.7.2 (used to save gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx) and LibreOffice 26.2.4.2 (used by managed_recalculated_xlsx at grading time). Even passing gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx directly to verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells yields score=0.0 with 97 modification errors at the exact same NCD cells (NCD!AA137, AB134, AB137, AC134, AC137).
confirmation: All 3 trials in run <id> fail identically with 648 errors such as 'NCD!AA137: answer=-3.375e-13, output=-3.801e-13'. NCD formulas are identical in input and GT, and only near-zero float residue differs (input 1.07e-14 vs GT -3.38e-13), which the relative-tolerance check treats as a mismatch.
fix: files/gt/gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx: set the cached value of 4,657 formula cells whose cached value was floating-point residue (0 < |v| < 1e-9; NCD 1,981, TL 2,674, Cash Flow F48/H48) to exactly 0. Formulas and every other cell unchanged. The verifier's 1% relative test then becomes an absolute 0.01 test on these cells, so recalculation noise no longer fails.
